method: Full live re-audit of sitemap marketing pages plus the prior brand-number inventory, scored against 3,000+ venues and $5B transactions processed.

sourceOfTruth.label: Venues worldwide
sourceOfTruth.controlled: Logo-Set module default + per-page Heading-Composition copy
sourceOfTruth.blurb: The venue count. Appears more often than any other brand number and is the one most likely to be quoted back at us.

sourceOfTruth.label: Transactions processed
sourceOfTruth.blurb: The headline money figure. Live site copy now uses “transactions processed” (formerly “guest revenue processed”). Year-in-Review pages may still carry frozen annual numbers on purpose.

findings: No retired venue figures (2,600 / 2,300) on marketing pages or in blog copy.
No retired revenue figures ($4B / $3B) on marketing pages or in blog copy.
Guest-revenue phrasing is gone. Live copy uses transactions processed.
A shared company-stats block now puts 3,000 customers and $5B on 41 pages. All of those match the source of truth.
Logo-set is on 90 pages, every one reading Trusted by over 3,000 venues worldwide.
Previously unreadable Stats-Set modules now resolve to page-level figures (support uptime, year-in-review results, pricing proof points).
Business Solutions says “$5B transaction processed” — the figure is $5B, the word transaction is missing an s.
Review badges are still images, so 38 User-Reviews pages stay unverified.
